headline: Elon Musk suggested on X that he could start a rival to Amazon after a user said Amazon was stopping Grok Bot shopping agents from placing orders.
score_reason: Widely reported, but Musk's remark was an offhand post with no plan, and the Amazon block itself is reported through users and Amazon's earlier comment on a different agent.
importance_line: Shoppers who send AI agents to buy for them may find big retailers refusing those agents, and Amazon's stance shows that stores, not agent makers, may decide which assistants can shop, though Musk's rival store is only an idea.
summary: India Today reports that Elon Musk, head of SpaceX and Tesla, wrote on X, "Maybe we should start a competitor to Amazon," after a user said Amazon was blocking Grok Bot, the AI shopping agent from Musk's SpaceX-owned xAI business, from placing orders; Musk gave no details or plan, and Teslarati notes Amazon has not commented on the Grok block. The remark comes amid a wider dispute over AI shopping agents: Amazon told GeekWire it blocked Meta's Muse agent because Meta had not warned it, the agent did not identify itself and it appeared to store customer credentials.
notes: Original investing.com article blocked (403); read India Today, Teslarati and Not a Tesla App instead; India Today is the credited outlet and url. Original listed source was investing.com.
